name: tugduck
description: Agile software-development subagents managed by PM2 and configured per project with .tugduck/config.json.

interface.shortDescription: Run PM2-managed subagents from project config.
interface.longDescription: Coordinate isolated, monitorable software-development subagents. Tugduck creates <project-root>/.tugduck/config.json on first use; configure the WSH server, PM2 processes, agent profiles, and API keys there. TUGDUCK_CONFIG may override the path.
defaultPrompt: Use Tugduck to launch a Codex subagent for this scoped project task.
